# Keep the cadence when empty

`customer_support.pb.de_escalation.keep_the_cadence_when_empty` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Send the promised update on time even when it contains no progress.

The empty update is the only one that proves the cadence is real, because it is the only one that had no other reason to be sent. Teams skip precisely these and then wonder why the customer stopped believing the schedule.
